## ACCEPT · objectui#13004 · PR #13007 · `domain:ui#2` · `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB` · 2026-10-19T00:49Z

PR #13007 at head `f4c3fe5` (`Fixes #13004`), reviewed against the claim `6257041612` and the dev report `6257177936`.

- **Diff read by the seat (8 files, +212/−9), inside the claimed surface:**
  - `liftPlanCard` (`mapMessages.ts`) lifts `nameField.generated` as `{ line }` only when it is an object with a non-empty string `line`. `template` is not drawn, so it is not lifted; a malformed value is dropped with no throw. This is the objectui#12994 pattern.
  - `PlanCardObjectRows` draws `generated.line` in place of the plain 「名称：LABEL」 line, keeping the same testid and adding `data-generated="true"`. An object without the key renders as before.
- **Chips as given:** cloud `f7ab9cc8` already leaves the title field out of `fields[]` when `generated` is present, so there is no client-side filter, as ruled.
- **Vendored schema:** `__tests__/fixtures/build-cards.schema.ts` is re-copied from cloud `f7ab9cc8`. Its diff is the `generated` subtree plus the header sha; the body matches cloud's file byte for byte. `planEnvelope(lang, { generatedTitle: true })` is opt-in, so the existing objectui#12724 pins keep their negative case.
- **Clause-②: no.** `ProposedPlanCard` and `liftPlanCard` are not exported. Changeset `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot: patch`.
- **Accepted deviation:** `buildCards.contract-12724.test.ts` gains two `it.each` cases that check the new envelope against the producer schema in zh and en. It is a test beside the files, and it keeps the fixture header's promise.
- **Pins:** (a) an object with `generated` draws its line and not the plain line (zh and en); (b) one without it is unchanged (CONTROL); (c) the lift keeps a well-formed `generated` and drops six malformed shapes. Ablation: deleting the lift turned (a) and (c) red, 10 others green; the restore was proven by blob hash.
- **Local gates (dev report):** 12 files / 148 tests across the `buildCards` / `planCard` / `mapMessages` families; `plugin-chatbot` type-check 0; narrowed eslint 0; the pre-tsc battery and the changeset checks all 0. The full `packages/plugin-chatbot/` dir is declared to CI.
- **Commits:** trailers are model-free.
- **Out-of-scope findings:** none.
- **CI at head:** 36/36 check-runs success or skipped on `f4c3fe5` (filter=latest), `mergeable_state` clean.

Verdict: **ACCEPT**. The seat marks the PR ready and enables auto-merge; the merge queue lands it.
